about: East Gwillimbury is a town in York Region north of Newmarket, covering Holland Landing, Sharon, Queensville, and Mount Albert rather than one downtown. It sits on the Holland River and the Oak Ridges Moraine and has been among the fastest-growing municipalities in the region. GO Transit’s East Gwillimbury station and Highway 404 feed new housing around the older villages. About 35,000 people live in East Gwillimbury.
